caveats: Grid is 0.02 deg, so analysed cells (centres within the bounds) span lat 57.14-58.32, lon 22.80-23.98 (60x60 cells; 3301 are sea cells, i.e. finite SST on every target day; corner land cells are 0 in the mask). Pool statistics use only baseline years 1992-2002, but as prescribed, day-of-year pools additionally include SST from 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05 (overflow days are pool values, not baseline days). Day 60 (29 February) has no pool of its own: its threshold and climatology are the mean of days 59 and 61 before smoothing. A day is hot when SST (kelvin) >= threshold. The climatology was computed as prescribed but does not enter the MHW definition. Quantiles use MATLAB-default (Hyndman-Fan type 5, numpy method='hazen'). One regional MHW event found: 2014-07-24..2014-08-18 (26 active days; cells inside a per-cell MHW range from 79 on the first day to 3269 at peak).
